seatMission: Evaluate whether a Vice President recommendation deserves progression to Strategist integration.
seatResponsibilities: Evaluate the assigned material transition through the Purpose criterion and issue one criterion-specific governance vote with rationale without erasing evidence, dissent, contradictions or invalidation conditions and without replacing the underlying production analysis.
qualityFocus: The recommendation remains aligned with the declared mission and intended outcome.
Executive materiality, conditions and readiness for Strategist integration or human decision.

provenance.mappingRule: Council IV Approval + Purpose criterion -> 10 dimensions -> 10 positive statements each; the Elder votes only this criterion and never replaces VP analysis, collective Council approval, Strategist integration, or Human Decision Owner authority.
